reddit.title: Introducing New Features for a More Interactive Colony Experience
reddit.body: We're excited to share some updates that will enhance your gameplay in Provincia! Our latest features include thought badges for settlers that display their needs and activities, a problem-alert stack that keeps you informed of issues in real-time, and visual feedback when placing or removing buildings. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

posts: Discover how our new thought badges will keep you connected with your settlers' needs and activities! Learn more: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back

embed.title: When the Colony Talks Back
embed.description: Explore the new features that make your settlement more interactive and responsive. From thought badges to problem alerts, your colony will keep you informed like never before!

steam.title: New Interactive Features in Provincia!
steam.body: We're enhancing your colony management experience with new features! Settlers will now display badges indicating their needs, and you'll receive alerts for any issues that arise in real-time. Plus, enjoy improved feedback when placing or removing buildings. Learn more about these updates and how they will improve your gameplay: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/when-the-colony-talks-back?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=when-the-colony-talks-back
